join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 2

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hello
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 4

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :hi there
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 6


# Ignored messages do not increment count.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!ignore add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to ignored users.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :hi there
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :hi there
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 8


# Filtered messages do not increment count.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter links on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 11

handle hortbot foobar/1 other/3 message-id=a8649dd0-95e0-11e9-b475-0800200c9a66 :check out my cool website! example.com

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_message_count
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 12
